mapper.select: /** getOperationMapData **/ SELECT map_data FROM user_map WHERE id = #{mapId}

/** getAqmList **/ SELECT d.id , dm.area_id , d.serial , d.device_name , IFNULL(dm.x_image, "0") as x , IFNULL(dm.y_image, "0") as y FROM device d INNER JOIN device_map dm ON d.id = dm.device_id WHERE dm.map_id = #{mapId} AND d.linked_yn = 'Y' AND (d.device_type = 'AQM' OR d.device_type = 'AQM_WLS')
